profile.headline: CEO at Graphmatics Ltd
profile.summary: Dedicated to the mathematical support of fractals.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
* Contract Design and Stress analysis of Subsea Drilling and Production components using   
  ProEngineer 3D modeling software, Perl and Abaqus and Ansys Finite Element
  Software.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
* Contract Design and Stress analysis of Subsea Drilling and Production components using
  SolidEdge 3D modeling software, Perl and Ansys Design Star Finite Element Software.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
* Project management for design of Subsea Blow Out Preventer stacks in accordance with
  API 16/16A using AutoCAD, ProEngineer, and Glovia ERP software.
* Used Abaqus Solver, Patran and ProEngineer to conduct stress analysis of Surface and
   Subsea Blow Out Preventer Stack components.
* Used Marc Nonlinear Solver, Patran and ProEngineer to design new Elastomeric/Rubber
  components for Oilfield Blow Out Preventer MultiRams. 
* Analysis, Design, and Coding of TruView Piping Systems Corrosion Analysis Display
  software in accordance with ASME B31G using Microsoft Visual Studio.
* Design and implementation of all TruView Graphical and Database reporting of Pipeline
  Corrosion data using Microsoft SQL, ODBC, DB Table design, Stored Procedures, Java,
  Perl, JavaScript, Crystal Reports, ActiveX and OLE Office Automation techniques.

positions.title: Engineering Programmer
positions.description:
* Analysis, Design, and Coding of TRIFLEX Multithreaded Microsoft Visual C++/Fortran
  software to conduct Piping Stress Analysis in accordance with ASME B31.X.
* Provided online and printed documentation for the TRIFLEX piping stress program using
  the RoboHelp HTML Help system.  
* Provide technical support to user of the TRIFLEX piping stress program to include
  installation assist, accepting bug reports and assisting users in the modeling of piping
  systems.

positions.title: Lieutenant Commander
positions.description:
* All aspects of the Design, Repair and Salvage of U.S. Naval vessels including
  coordinating and supervision of steam boiler and condenser repairs, installation of
  rotating equipment, installation of structural members, Work Package validation, Dry- 
  Docking calculations, A/C piping/compressor design and installation, Electrical
  generators/motor generators and motors, and configuration control. In Depth knowledge 
  and experience in the salvage of aged vessels.
Capabilities:
* In-depth experience in C/C++, Perl, Microsoft Visual C++, Microsoft Visual FoxPro,
  Microsoft SQL, ODBC, Database Table design, Stored Procedures, Perl, Java, JavaScript,
  Crystal Reports, ActiveX and OLE Office Automation techniques, Visual Fortran,
  MATLAB, COBOL, and DBASE IV with an excellent command of Microsoft Visual
  Studio and Visual Studio Dot Net. In-depth knowledge of the Windows 2000/XP/Vista
  and Unix/Linux/Cygwin Operating Systems including setup and operation of the Apache
  web server (http://graphmatics.org/). Well versed in Finite Element Structural Analysis
  and Design; In-depth training in all aspects of Pure/Applied Mathematics with
  research interests including Fractal Analysis, Numerical Methods, and The Finite Element
  Method.
